verses.1: A prayer for Asaf Elohim is offered before God, in the presence of Elohim.
verses.2: Until death, they will be judged unjustly; and before the eyes of the wicked, they will be brought low.
verses.3: Hear their cases; let the poor and needy be treated kindly.
verses.4: May Phaltu-Dal and Ebin be saved from the hands of the wicked.
verses.5: They will not know, nor understand, in their depths. They will be led astray by all the rulers of the earth.
verses.6: I have said, “God, you and your sons are all equal.”
verses.7: Now, as a human being, you will die; and as one of the prophets, you will also be destroyed.
verses.8: God stood judgment over the earth, for you will reign over all nations.
